snippet.title: Kill The Sea Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist Kill the Sea on Steam!

Sail your way to victory on a deadly campaign across the Seven Seas in a seafaring sandbox survivors-like. Hunt menacing beasts of legend, complete deliveries, win races, defend outposts, find treasures or gamble it all in an oceanic world driven by chaos, risk, and opportunity.
